note: The test generates the WAV from this recipe. No binary WAV is committed. Tones are sine waves, silences are exact zero samples. Only the silences decide where the chunker cuts; the tone values are not part of any expected result.
sample_formula: tone: int(round(amplitude * math.sin(2 * math.pi * frequency_hz * n / sample_rate_hz))) with n the global sample index of the file (not the index inside the segment); silence: 0

cut_design.reason: the only all-zero 20 ms frames in the region are the 50 frames inside the silence; a tie goes to the latest, which is window-relative frame 1149; cut = 1149 * 480 + 240
chunk 2 starts at 551760, so its 20 ms frames are aligned to 551760 + 480 * k; the last frame wholly inside the silence is k = 1149; cut = 551760 + 1149 * 480 + 240

unrelated_silences: 9.80 s to 10.20 s, 35.80 s to 36.20 s and 57.80 s to 58.20 s lie outside both search regions on purpose, so that they cannot change a cut
